tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rdo rje tshe'i phrin las zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

rgya gar skad du: a pā ra mi ta ā yur+dzñā na karma nā ma: bod skad du: tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i phrin las zhes bya ba: mgon po tshe'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: 'chi med tshe'i phrin las kyi rim pa ni: gnas dben par dkyil 'khor dang tshe'i sgrub rdzas sogs dbang chog rgyas pa ltar 'du bya la: stan bde bar 'dug ste thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni: hrīḥ bdag dang khams gsum sems can ma lus pa: dus 'di nas bzung byang chub ma thob bar: 'chi med 'khor lo'i dbang phyug lha tshogs la: rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis skyabs su mchi: zhes gsum dang : sems bskyed pa ni: hrīḥ mkha' mnyam 'gro kun 'chi bdag bdud bcom nas: tshe dbang rig 'dzin go 'phang la 'god phyir: bdag gis 'chi med tshe yi phrin las sgrub: smon 'jug don dam sems mchog bskyed par bgyi: zhes gsum bya: bgegs gtor chab kyis bran te byin rlabs spyi 'gro ltar byas la: bka' bsgo ba ni: hrīḥ bka' gsang 'chi med tshe yi dkyil 'khor 'dir: bdag dang slob ma'i tshogs su bcas pa rnams: tshe dbang rig 'dzin go 'phang bsgrub pa la: bar gcod 'byung po bgegs rigs gang su dag: mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya chen 'di khyer la: rang rang gnas su zhi ba'i sems kyis song : bde bar sdod la chos kyi don bsgoms te: snying rje'i yid kyis khyod rgyud yongs grol nas: myur du thar pa'i go 'phang thob gyur cig: ces dang*/ suṃ bha ni'i sngags kyis bskrad la: mtshams bcad pa ni: rang nyid rta mgrin gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas: hrīḥ nga ni pad+ma he ru kaḥ thugs las sprul pa'i rta mchog dpal: khro bo kun gyi pho nya yin: spyi gtsug rta skad thengs gsum gyis: 'jig rten srid pa'i rtse mo 'dar: bar du hrīḥyi rngam sgra yis: lha min srin po gnod sbyin brgyal: 'og tu zhabs kyis bro brdungs bas: sa gzhi rgya mtsho 'chol zhing rdeg: sku las bskal pa'i me 'bar bas:

dregs pa sde brgyad thams cad sreg: nga ni dbang chen rgyal po yin: nga yi bka' las su 'da' na: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bya: khro rgyal tshogs kyis mtshams chod cig: ces brjod la nga rgyal dang ldan pas srung 'khor bsgom: mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du: pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shapad pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes brjod| bdud rtsi byin rlabs ni/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i rtsa brgyad lan lag stong du sbyar ba'i 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po reg bya bsil zhing ro brgya dang ldan pa nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ zhes gsum brjod/ mchod gtor byin rlabs ni/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hrīḥyig dkar po yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed nus pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'dod yon phun sum tshogs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ ā hūm̐ ma hā ling+ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ zhes gsum brjod/ rang nyid mgon po tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīḥyig las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar tshe dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par spyan drangs par dmigs te ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/

'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med// ces sho lo ka gcig dang*/ bstod par 'os pa thams cad la// zhes sho lo ka gcig gis bstod/ gus pa dang bcas pas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi| |zhes pa nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa'i bar gyis rgyun bshags bya: tshogs zhing rnams rang gi spyi gtsug tu thim par gyur:par mos la: bdag gi rnal 'byor gyi rim pa ni| bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las phyi rol ye shes kyi me ri 'bar zhing sna tshogs rdo rje'i gur khang gi nang du/ khro rgyal rta mgrin gyi sku che chung dpag tu med pas gang ba'i dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i ze'u 'bru dmar ser gyi dbus su nyi ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ hrīḥyig dmar po las skyes pa'i rang nyid skad cig gis mgon po tshe dpag med sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing 'tsher ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas pad+ma'i sdong po thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi steng na tshe'i bum pa 'dzin pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings ba'i rtser rin po ches spras pa: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha lugs can dar dmar po dang rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan gyis spras pa/ gzi brjid kyi 'od 'phro zhing shin tu lhan ne lhang nge lham mer snang la rang bzhin med par gsal ba'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa'i rnam par spyan drangs te dam tshig pa la thim pas gnyis su med pa thim par bsam la/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ bstod pa ni/ hrīḥ bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: dus gsum bde gshegs kun 'dus sku: mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sku mnga' ba: mnyam nyid sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku stod pad+ma rā ga 'dra: phyag gnyis pad+ma tshe bum 'dzin:

tshe bcud bdud rtsis bkang nas kyang : dngos grub stsol la phyag 'tshal bstod: yon tan ma lus bskyed mdzad cing : sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs kyis bskor: tshe dpal dngos grub stsol mdzad pa'i: 'chi med rdo rje'i sku la bstod: ji ltar pad+ma sangs rgyas pas: khams gsum rnam par khyab mdzad cing : thugs rjes phyogs bcur gzigs mdzad cing : dpag med mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod: lha klu gnod sbyin gdon gyi tshogs: zhi bar mdzad cing dbang du bsdud: tshe dang bsod nams rgyas mdzad pa'i: 'chi med dbang po'i sku la bstod: ces bstod la bzlas pa bya ba ni: rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba'i dbus su hrīḥyig dmar po'i mthar bzla bya'i sngags dmar gsal gdan la khab btsug pa lta bu'i 'od zer gyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i tshe'i rig 'dzin dang dngos grub thams cad bsdus te sa bon la thim par dmigs te/ oṃ badz+ra dzñā na a yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūṃ ṇi dzaḥ zhes ci nus kyi bar du bzlas pa bya'o: de dag ni bdag gi rnal 'byor sgom pa'i rim pa'o: de nas tshe'i bum bskyed ni/ bum pa gnyis bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las tshe'i bum pa dbyibs zlum pa lto ba ldir ba kha g.yel ba mchu 'phyang ba/ zhabs zhum pa mgrin pa phra ba lha rdzas kyi gos dmar pos mgul bcings shing*/ dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa 'od zer kha dog sna lnga 'phro ba/ de'i nang du āḥlas bum chu dkar po bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hrīḥyig tsheg drag dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku/mdog pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po lta bu zhal 'dzum zhing mtshan dpes brgyan pa phyag g.yas pad+ma'i sdong po'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/

g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas tshe'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dbu skra mthing nag spyi bor phyed bcings kyi rtser rin po ches brgyan pa'i lhag ma rgyab tu grol ba dbu la rin po che'i prog zhu gsol ba| dar dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs lhab lhab tu gsol ba/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi snyan rgyan mgul rgyan se mo do dang do shal ska rag phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub la sogs pas brgyan pa sku snang la rang bzhin med pa mtshan dpe'i gzi brjid 'bar ba 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs 'khrugs pa'i dbus su bzhugs pa/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma la mdun du rnam snang tshe dpag med mthing nag 'khor lo dang tshe bum 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yas su rin 'byung tshe dpag med ser po rin po che dang tshe bum 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/ rgyab tu snang mtha' tshe dpag med dmar po pad+ma dang tshe bum 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/ g.yon du don grub tshe dpag med ljang gu rgya gram dang tshe bum 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rnams phyag g.yas tshe'i mda' dar kha dog lnga ldan me long gis brgyan pa 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas tshe'i bum pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ yab yum thams cad dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i gnas gsum la yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa'i tshogs spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ ces dmigs shing*/ sngar ltar mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ dzam+bu gling gi mchod yon ji snyed pa: bdag pos bzung dang yongs su ma bzung ba: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul te: mgon po tshe yi lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na pañtsa de wa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐: zhes zhabs bsil nas rol mo'i bar sbyar bas mchod:

bstod pa ni: hrīḥ bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: gos dkar yum dang mnyam par sbyor: tshe dpal dngos grub stsol mdzad pa'i: thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal bstod: bcom ldan rdo rje tshe dpag med: sangs rgyas spyan dang mnyam par sbyor: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku mnga' ba: thugs mchog yab yum phyag 'tshal bstod: bcom ldan rin chen tshe dpag med: mā ma kā+-i dang mnyam par sbyor: bde chen lhun grub sku mnga' ba: yon tan yab yum phyag 'tshal bstod: bcom ldan sangs rgyas tshe dpag med: dbyings phyug yum dang mnyam par sbyor: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor mdzad pa'i: sku mchog yab yum phyag 'tshal bstod: bcom ldan karma tshe dpag med: sgrol ma yab yum phyag 'tshal bstod: sems cad bde la 'god mdzad pa'i: phrin las yab yum phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bstod la: bzlas pa bya ba ni: rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba lha so so'i sku mdog can re re spros pas gzung thag la brgyud de song*/ bum lha gtso 'khor gyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i dbus su hrīḥyig lha rang rang gi mdog can re re'i mtha' skor du 'bru tshugs su 'khor ba las/ bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul bas lha so so'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma thams cad kyi byin rlabs dang*/ lha mi kun gyi bsod nams dang tshe bkrag /tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin rnams kyi tshe dpal 'byung ba lnga'i bcud thams cad bsdus te bdud rtsi'i rnam par lha so so'i thugs kar thim zhing*/ thugs ka'i sa bon las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med du 'dres pa 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub stsol ba'i nus mthu dang ldan par gyur/ ces dmigs la: oṃ badz+ra dzñā na a yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūṃ ṇi dzaḥ zhes ma yeng bar ci nus bzla'o: de nas las bum gyi nang du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa bskyed la:

oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces ci nus bzla'o: de nas slar yang bum pa'i lha gtso 'khor la mchod bstod rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar ba phul la/ bdag gi tshe la bar chad med par gyur cig: 'chi bdag gi bdud las thar bar gyur cig: tshe yongs su smin cing grol bar gyur cig: tshe rgyas par gyur cig: tshe mthar phyin pa'i lus des kyang 'gro don dpag tu med pa byed nus par gyur cig: mthar bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa las thar nas mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig: ces smon lam tshar gsum btab la: bum pa'i lha ye shes pa rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs: dam tshig pa yab yum 'khor bcas 'od du zhu ba bum pa'i chu dang ro gcig par gyur: rdo rje bdud rtsi 'khyil bas 'dir tshe'i dbang dang sgrub pa dang phrin las mthar ma phyin gyi bar de srid du bar du gcod pa'i bgegs thams cad zlog cing zhi bar mdzod cig /ces brjod la de ltar dmigs so// de ni tshe bum dang las bum sgrub pa'i cho ga dag go: de nas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa ni: hrīḥ chos sku skye med nam mkha' lta bu la: thugs rje chen pos sems can kun la khyab: rgyu las kun skyes yi ge hūm̐ du gsal: hūm̐ las 'od 'phros 'byung ba rim brtsegs gsal: e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ suṃ bh+rūṃ: 'byung ba rim brtsegs steng du ni: bh+rūṃ las rin chen gzhal yas khang : gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan dang ldan: rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gu dang : dra ba ba ku mda' yab bcas: bcu gcig ldan pa'i rta babs rgyan: gu ṇa ha ris spras pa la: chos 'khor gser gdugs ri dwags mtshan: gzhal yas dkar ser dmar ljang ba'i: phyogs bzhi'i mdog can gsal zhing mdzes: phyi rol pad+ma rdo rje dang: ye shes me yi ra bas bskor: dkyil 'khor chen po de yi dbus: gru chad ljang gu'i lte ba ru: pad+ma 'dab brgyad rigs kyi gdan: mu khyud gong ras mdzes pa'i dbus:

pad+ma sūr+ya tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ bh+rūṃ hrīḥ dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus kyi lte ba ru: rin chen khri rkang rma bya brgyad bsnol steng : pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan steng du: hrīḥlas bcom ldan rdo rje tshe dpag med: sku mdog dkar po mnyam bzhag tshe bum 'dzin: yum chen na bza' dkar mo gnyis med 'khril: dar dang rin chen rgyan ldan longs sku'i tshul: snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku ru gyur: shar gyi 'dab mar rnam snang tshe dpag med: mthing ga phyag gnyis 'khor lo tshe bum 'dzin: sangs rgyas spyan ma yum dang mnyam par sbyor: lho yi 'dab mar rin 'byung tshe dpag med: sku mdog ser po rin chen tshe bum 'dzin: mā ma kī yum mnyam sbyor 'khril zhing bzhugs: nub kyi 'dab mar snang mtha' tshe yi bdag: sku mdog dmar po pad+ma tshe bum 'dzin: dbyings phyug yum dang 'khril sbyor dgyes par bzhugs: byang gi 'dab mar don grub tshe yi bdag: sku mdog ljang gu rgya gram tshe bum bsnams: sgrol ma yum dang mnyam sbyor bde bar bzhugs: yab yum dar dang rin chen du mas brgyan: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha lugs tshul du gsal: yum rnams phyag g.yas tshe dar nam mkhar phyar: g.yon rnams tshe bum bzung nas yab la 'khyud: bde stong lhan skyes rol pa'i cho 'phrul gyis: dga' bzhi ye shes ngang du lhan cig bzhugs: shar lho'i 'dab mar lhun grub rig 'dzin ni: dkar po phyag gnyis tshe dar tshe bum bsnams: lho nub 'dab mar phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin ni: ser po phyag gnyis tshe dar tshe bum bsnams: nub byang 'dab mar tshe dbang rig 'dzin ni: dmar po phyag gnyis tshe dar tshe bum bsnams: byang gi 'dab mar rnam smin rig 'dzin ni: ljang gu phyag gnyis tshe dar tshe bum bsnams: kun kyang dar dang rin chen mang pos brgyan: rdo rje'i skyil krung 'od zer 'bar zhing bzhugs: gru chad shar lho nub byang zur bzhi ru: lā s+ye dkar mo mā l+ye ser mo dang :

gī ti' dmar mo nṛ t+ye ljang gsal ma: dhū pe dkar mo puṣ+pe ser mo dang : ā lo ke dmar gan+dhe ljang mo rnams: rang rtags phyag mtshan dang bcas tshe dar dang: tshe bum bsnams nas sems skyil gar gyis bzhugs: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes par brgyan: sgo bzhir lha mo dkar ser dmar ljang bzhi: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu dang : tshe dar tshe bum bsnams nas dor stabs bsgyings: rin chen dar bklubs sgo bzhi bsrung ba'i tshul: ye shes 'od lnga dra ba'i klong du gsal: kun gyi gnas gsum oṃ dkar āḥdamar dang : hūm̐ mthing thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas: bde gshegs thams cad mgon po tshe yi lha: dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rnam par spyan drangs te: gnyis med dam tshig pa la thim par gyur: ces dmigs la spyan drangs pa ni: hrīḥ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams nas: bcom ldan rdo rje tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: 'chi med rig 'dzin dngos grub stsol ba'i phyir: thugs dam tshul bzhin spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: e h+ye hi bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: zhes dang*/ bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hrīḥ bcom ldan mgon po tshe yi lha tshogs dang : sku gsum sprul pa'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: rin chen nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng du: tshe dpal dngos grub stsol phyir bzhugs su gsol: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ba ni: hrīḥ bcom ldan tshe yi lha tshogs 'khor bcas rnams: ye shes chen po gsal ba'i sku mnga' ba: thugs rjes 'gro ba sems can don mdzad pa'i: 'chi med lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: na mo pu ru ṣ+ya hoḥ mchod pa 'bul ba ni: sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs la: hrīḥ dri med yid 'ong gtsang mar sbyar ba yi: mchod yon me tog bdug spos mar me dang: dri chab zhal zas snyan pa'i rol mo 'bul: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: 'dod yon drug gi mchod pa rgya chen 'bul:

sarba pū dza khā hi: zhes dang*/ slar yang ar+ghaṃ nas shapada'ibar dang : rū pa nas spar+she'i bar sngags kyis mchod la: gtor ma la bdud rtsis bran te spyi 'gro ltar byin gyis brlabs la: dbul ba ni: hrīḥ rin chen snod du mdzes pa'i gtor ma ni: kha dog dri ro reg bya nus par ldan: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar bdud rtsi'i bcud: 'chi med lha la 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol: ā yur+dzñā na de wa sa pa ri wā ra ba ling+ta pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi: zhes phul la: bstod pa ni: hrīḥ bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med: sku mdog dkar po gangs ri'i mdog 'dra ba: phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag tshe yi bum pa bsnams: zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung brtan par bzhugs: yum chen lha mo gos dkar mo dang 'khril: yab yum rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes: tshe dang dpal gyi dngos grub stsol mdzad pa'i: 'chi med tshe yi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang: gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal: thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i: rigs lnga yab yum sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrīḥ lhun grub rig 'dzin phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin dang : tshe dbang rig 'dzin rnam smin rig 'dzin sogs: 'chi med rdo rje lta bu'i sku brnyes pa'i: 'chi med rig 'dzin tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: lā s+ye mā l+ye gī tī nṛ t+ye ma: dhū pe puṣ+pe ā lo gan+dhe ma: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu ma: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bstod la dzab bzla ba ni: oṃ badz+ra dzñā na a yu ṣe hūm̐ bh+rūṃ nṛ dza: zhes dgongs pa dang ldan pas ci nus bzla bar bya'o: de nas tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni: tshogs kyi yo byad la chu bran te: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gyis mi gtsang sbyangs la: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes byin gyis brlabs la: 'bul ba ni: hrīḥ 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs la:

zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i mchod pa 'bul: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: ā yur+dzñā na de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: zhes phul la/ tshogs dang bdud rtsi la longs spyad la lhag ma bsdus te: slob dpon gyi kha chus bran la: a kā ro gsum dang*/ oṃ u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba ling+ta khā hi: zhes lhag ma btang ngo: de nas tshe 'gugs pa ni: sgrub pa pos tshe'i mda' dar g.yab cing : a yur+dzñā na bh+rūṃ: oṃ badz+ra a mu ta hoḥ sa ma ya bo dhi tsit+ta badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe hūm̐ a āḥ hūm̐ bh+rūṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe hūm̐ āḥ oṃ bh+rūṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe hūm̐ āḥ swā bh+rūṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe hūm̐ āḥ āḥbh+rūṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe hūm̐ āḥ hā bh+rūṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe hūm̐ āḥ hrīḥbh+rūṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe hūm̐ āḥ zhes re re la brgya rtsa re bzla'o: de nas tshe'i lha tshogs kyi thugs dam pho nya bskul ba ni: hūm̐ bh+rūṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe hūm̐ āḥ hrīḥ bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: sku ni nam mkha'i bag rdul med: phyag g.yas rdo rje tshe dar can: g.yon pa bum pa rin chen phreng: yang gsang thugs kyi ga'u nas: snying po thugs kyi a yu 'di: mgon po'i tshe bzhag gnas 'di yin: bdag cag tshe 'di gnas par mdzod: ces bskul bas yab yum kyi sbyor mtshams nas snying po tshe'i 'od 'phros pas lo ka'i khams khengs par bsam mo: de nas bskul ba ni: hrīḥ bcom ldan mgon po rdo rje tshe dpag med: thugs rje'i dbang gis 'gro ba'i don la byon: mkha' dbyings rnam dag yum gyi gzhal yas nas: byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi 'od du 'phro: skal ldan bdag la tshe yi dngos grub stsol: zhes brjod la: thog mar sems ma bzhi'i tshe 'gugs pa ni: hrīḥ shar gyi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: lā s+ye dkar mo tshe yi bdag: phyag na tshe yi bum pa bsnams: tshe dang dpal gyi phrin las mdzod:

hrīḥ lho yi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: mā l+ye sngon mo tshe yi bdag: phyag na mthing gi bum pa bsnams: tshe dang dpal gyi phrin las mdzod: hrīḥ nub kyi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: gī tī dmar mo tshe yi bdag: phyag na mchong gi bum pa bsnams: tshe dang dpal gyi phrin las mdzod: hrīḥ byang gi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: nṛ t+ye ljang gu tshe yi bdag: phyag na g.yu yi bum pa bsnams: tshe dang dpal gyi phrin las mdzod: de nas yum bzhi'i tshe 'gugs ni: hrīḥ lus kyi sha yi khams nyams na: 'byung ba sa yi bcud bsdus shing: sangs rgyas spyan mas tshe khug la: bdag la tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hrīḥ lus kyi khrag gi khams nyams na: 'byung ba chu yi bcud bsdus shing: mā ma kī yis tshe khug la: bdag la tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hrīḥ lus kyi drod kyi khams nyams na: 'byung ba me yi bcud bsdus la: gos dkar mo yis tshe khug la: bdag la tshe yi dngos grub stsol: hrīḥ lus kyi dbugs kyi khams nyams na: 'byung ba rlung gi bcud bsdus la: dam tshig sgrol mas tshe khug la: bdag la tshe yi dngos grub stsol: zhes dang*/ de nas mgyogs ma bzhi'i tshe 'gugs pa ni: hūm̐ */ shar phyogs gangs ri dkar po'i gzhal yas nas: dkar mo mgyogs ma tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: thugs kyi sprul pa dkar mo mgyogs ma 'bum: rdo rje'i tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig: hūm̐ */ lho phyogs baiḍūr+ya yi zhing khams nas: sngon mo mgyogs ma tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: thugs kyi sprul pa sngon mo mgyogs ma 'bum: rdo rje'i tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig: hūm̐ */ nub phyogs pad+ma rā ga'i zhing khams nas: dmar mo mgyogs ma tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: thugs kyi sprul pa dmar mo mgyogs ma 'bum: rdo rje'i tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig: hūm̐ */ byang phyogs in+d+ra nī la'i zhing khams nas: ljang mo mgyogs ma tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: thugs kyi sprul pa ljang mo mgyogs ma 'bum:

rdo rje'i tshe mchog 'gugs pa'i las mdzod cig: ces dang*/ sgo ma bzhi'i tshe 'gugs pa ni/ mda' dar g.yab cing sgo ma so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ hūm̐ */ khams gsum gnas nas tshe 'gugs ma: lha mo rdo rje lcags kyu can: phyag na bse yi ga'u bsnams: drongs shig drongs shig tshe drongs shig: hūm̐ */ dus gsum gnas nas tshe 'gugs ma: lha mo rdo rje zhags pa ma: phyag na rdo rje zhags pa bsnams: drongs shig drongs shig tshe drongs shig: hūm̐ */ srid gsum gnas nas tshe 'gugs ma: lha mo rdo rje lcags sgrog ma: phyag na pad+ma bhan+dha bsnams: drongs shig drongs shig tshe drongs shig: hūm̐ */ sku gsum gnas nas tshe 'gugs ma: lha mo rdo rje dril bu ma: phyag na g.yu yi bum pa bsnams: drongs shig drongs shig tshe drongs shig: mgyogs ma rnams kyis tshe drongs shig: byin chen rnams kyis byin phob cig: gsang ba bzhi yi rgyas thob la: dbang chen rnams kyis dbang bskur zhig: oṃ bh+rūṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe hūm̐ āḥ a yu ṣe dzñā na dza dzaḥ zhes brjod la 'khor 'das thams cad kyi tshe'i dngos grub bsdus nas bdag dang tshe gtor tshe zan tshe chang rnams la thim par bsam mo: de nas tshe bstim zhing sba ba ni: hūm̐ */ nam mkha'i dbyings nas tshe 'gugs ma: bde gshegs yum chen kun tu bzang: rin chen gser gyi bum pa bsnams: tshe dang bdud rtsis bkang nas ni: 'khor lo 'bar bas rgyas thob cig: tshe 'di bcol lo srog 'di sdoms: hūm̐ */ shar gyi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: rdo rje'i yum chen sangs rgyas spyan: rin chen shel gyi bum pa bsnams: tshe dang dpal gyis bkang nas ni: rdo rje 'bar bas rgyas thob cig: tshe 'di bcol lo srog 'di sdoms: hūm̐ */ lho yi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: rin chen yum chen mā ma kī: rin chen mthing gi bum pa bsnams: tshe dang dpal gyis bkang nas ni: rin chen 'bar bas rgyas thob cig: tshe 'di bcol lo srog 'di sdoms:

hūm̐ */ nub kyi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: pad+ma'i yum chen na bza' dkar: pad+ma rā ga'i bum pa bsnams: tshe dang dpal gyis bkang nas ni: pad+ma 'bar bas rgyas thob cig: tshe 'di bcol lo srog 'di sdoms: hūm̐ */ byang gi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: las rab yum chen dam tshig sgrol: in+d+ra nī la'i bum pa bsnams: tshe dang bdud rtsis bkang nas ni: rgya gram 'bar bas rgyas thob cig: tshe 'di bcol lo srog 'di sdoms: zhes thun drug tu tshe 'gugs shing bstim mo: de nas tshe brtan par bya ba ni: hūm̐ tra tra shag mu dra hoḥtiṣ+ṭha lhan: zhes brjod/ de nas srod thun lta bu thun tha ma'i dus su dngos grub bskul zhing dbang zhu ba dang: rgyas gdab pa sogs bya ba'i skabs 'dir/ bdag 'jug bya ba ni/ dbang chog ltar nyams su blang ngo: thog mar tshe gtor rang gi mgor bzhag la: hūm̐ */ snying po skyod par mi nus te: rdo rje 'chang gi tshe yang tshe: spros pas khams su bkrag dang mdangs: bsdus pas lus la gzi mdangs 'bar: bcings pas rdo rje lu gu rgyud: brtan pas mi 'gyur rdo rje 'dra: skal ldan rdo rje'i dam tshig can: sku gsung thugs mchog dngos grub stsol: che mchog rdo rje'i hūm̐ rtag shog: hūm̐ badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ bud+dha ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: swā rat+na ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ: āḥ.a pad+ma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ hā karma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes brjod cing tshe gtor mgor bzhag la tshe ril rdog po gcig dang tshe chang hub gcig 'thung ngo: de nas tshe bstim pa ni: hrīḥ srid pa gsum gyi tshe bkrag rnams: yi ge bh+rūṃ la bstim par bya: bh+rūṃ de 'od du zhu ba las: tshe yi bum pa nyid la bstim: bum pa'i nang gi 'od zer rnams: 'byung ba'i snying po lnga la thim: e yaṃ raṃ baṃ suṃ: snying po lnga yi bkrag mdangs kyang : lha yi snying po lnga la thim: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā:

yi ge dpa' bo 'bru lnga po: rang gi snying khar thim pa yis: snying nang 'od kyi ga'ur gyur: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: zhes brjod/ de nas tshe gta' bsdam pa ni: tshe'i mda' dar gyis rgya gram gyi tshul du rang gi gnas so sor gtug cing: hrīḥ bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe dpag med: tshe lha rigs lnga rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi: lha mo brgyad dang sgo srung chen mo bzhi: 'byung ba lnga la dbang bsgyur lha yi tshogs: 'khor lo rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang : rgya gram 'bar ba'i phyag rgya rab bkra bas: bdag gi tshe dpal bsod nams gzi brjid la: gnod byed mi mthun bgegs kyi 'tshe ba las: yongs su srung la skyob pa'i phrin las mdzod: 'chi med mda' dar me long dar sna rnams: phyag mtshan yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgya yis thob: ces brjod cing bsrung ba'i rgyas gdab bo: de nas tshe bsrung ba ni: rang gi smin mtshams su mtshal gyi thig le bya zhing*/ hrīḥ tsit+ta gsang ba'i sgo srung ni: dbang gi rgyal po rta mgrin te: tshe srog bar chad srung bar mdzod: 'chi bdag bdud bzhi'i sgo chod la: tshe bdag chen po brtan par bzhugs: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hūm̐: badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: zhes brjod nang gi rtsa sgo rta mgrin gyis bsrungs: de nas phyi'i lus mgo mjug rdo rje'i go khrab kyis bsrung ba ni: rang gi gnas rnams su rdo rje rgya gram gtug cing : hūm̐ */ mi shig rdo rje'i go cha mchog: bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal: dug lnga'i mtshon la sra la brtan: rdo rje'i go khrab zhu lub tu: bgos te bsrung ba'i mchog thob shog: oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa haṃḥ zhes brjod cing rgyas gdab/ de nas bzlas pa la thun bsdu ba'i rjes kyi cho ga ni: mchod pa gsar pa bsham pa'am: rnying pa kha gsos la sngar ltar byin gyis brlabs te: oṃ ā yur+dzñā na de wa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā: zhes shap+ta'i bar mchod la/ hrīḥ

bcom ldan rgyal ba rigs lnga tshe yi bdag: 'chi med grub pa'i rig 'dzin chen po bzhi: sgeg sogs tshe'i lha mo rnam pa brgyad: bar chad srung ba'i sgo skyong ma bzhi sogs: tshe yi lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bstod la: smon lam gdab pa ni: bdag gi tshe la bar chad med par gyur cig: 'chi bdag gi bdud las thar bar gyur cig: tshe yongs su smin cing 'phel bar gyur cig: tshe rgyas par gyur cig: tshe'i bsam pa mthar phyin par gyur cig: tshe mthar phyin pa'i lus des kyang 'gro don dpag tu med pa byed nus par gyur cig: mthar bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa las rgyal nas mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig: ces lan gsum gyis smon lam btab: bdag cag ma rig dbang gyur pas: cho ga chad cing lhag pa dang : nor 'khrul bskyed rim ma gsal zhing: bzlas brjod ma dag rdzogs rim la: rtag chad mtha' ru bzung ba sogs: nongs gyur bgyis dang bgyid stsal ba: de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol: zhes dang yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs la: nub tha mar gshegs su gsol ba ni: oṃ/ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod: ji lta'i rjes mthun dngos grub stsol: sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang : slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol: badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs: dam tshig pa 'od du zhu nas rang gi snying khar thim par gyur: ces gshegs su gsol: bsngo ba ni: bdag gi rnam dkar dge 'di'i 'bras bu yis: bdag sogs 'gro kun 'chi med rig 'dzin gyi: go 'phang mchog nyid mngon du gyur nas kyang : gzhan don dpag med mthar ru phyin pa dang : bdud bzhi las grol mngon par rdzogs pa yi: sangs rgyas go 'phang myur du thob par shog: ces bsngo ba dang : bkra shis brjod pa ni: oṃ/ sku yi sku ste sku la thim: phung po lnga la rab tu thim: āḥ gsung gi gsung ste ngag la thim: ljags kyi dbang po lnga la thim: hūm̐/ thugs kyi thugs ste thugs la thim:

rang byung ye shes thugs la thim: hrīḥ nyin la bkra shis mtshan bkra shis: nyin mtshan rgyun du bkra shis pa: skal ldan rnams la bkra shis shog: snying po nyi zla gsal gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dzñā na hūm̐ hai: zhes dang gzhan yang bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa ci rigs pa rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar ba brjod: dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag: tshe yi lha tshogs 'grub gyur cig: 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa: de yi sa la 'god par shog: gzhan yang bsngo ba smon lam spyi 'gro ltar brjod: de nas tshe gtor tshe zan tshe chang rnams dngos grub tu longs spyad cing : gzhan yang dkyil 'khor gyi mchod rdzas lha bshos mchod gtor la sogs pa khyi dang bud med sprang po rnams la sbyin par mi bya'o: de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu zhing las kyi rjes mi mngon par byas la dmigs med kyis rgyas gdab par bya'o: zhes pa tshe'i phrin las 'di'ang ri dug sbrul spungs 'dra'i sked bse sgrom smug po'i nang nas rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyis gdan drangs pa las: tshe'i sgrub chen dang phrin las bstod byang sogs so sor 'dug pa phyogs gcig tu dril te: rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas brag dkar lha chu'i gnas chen du lcags mo bya lo hor zla gsum pa phyi ma'i dmar cha'i rdzogs pa gnyis pa'i tshes la bsgrigs pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
